integrity: Proof and finite exact-rational checker provided. Approximate phase digits are not a rigorous numeric interval enclosure. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact five-element cyclic group and generating two-point inputs only; no general five-point law, higher cyclic order, or alternative entropy functional classified. The lead preprint was not available in full text for priority comparison.
title: A sharp entropy-resistance phase for Bernoulli laws on the five-cycle
